description:
Activate Kumena's first ability by tapping another nontoken Merfolk you control.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
When the Merfolk enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Kumena ability, causing it to be unable to be blocked this turn.
Repeat.
You may activate Kumena's other abilities instead once you control enough Merfolks to do so, ensuring to tap at least one nontoken Merfolk each activation.
